# Expense Reimbursement Policy

## Scope

This policy covers mileage claims, meal allowances, hotel costs, and receipts required for reimbursement.

## Mileage claims

- mileage must include route, date, and business purpose
- passenger count must be recorded separately
- rates are versioned by effective date

## Daily allowances

- domestic allowance applies only when travel duration exceeds the threshold in the yearly rate table
- part-day and full-day allowances use separate limits

## Required receipts

- hotel invoices
- ferry tickets
- parking receipts over the approval threshold

## Accounting export note

The accounting CSV must include employee code, posting date, pay item code, quantity, and cost center columns.
